Subject: Post-call recap: HealthSynk private deployment & air-gap constraints

Thanks again for the time this morning, Alex — good conversation. Below is a short recap so we’re aligned and so I can loop in our SE for a technical deep-dive.

Quick recap of pain / drivers you shared:
- Regulatory requirement to store and process PHI on-prem (no cross-border replication).
- Primary constraint: strict air-gap for inference plane — no outbound internet egress from inference hosts.
- Authentication + key management must integrate with customer KMS/HSM (FIPS 140-2) and be auditable.
- Network: all traffic must be allowlisted by IP; TLS termination is inside customer network; proxy and internal forward-proxy behavior needs validation.
- Ops: 24/7 SLA for inference for a subset of endpoints (low-latency SLOs), and periodic audits (SOC2 evidence required).

Goals we discussed:
- Evaluate Redwood Private (on-prem appliance / VPC private deployment) options to support full air-gap or tightly restricted egress.
- Determine feasibility and timeline for a pilot (30–60 days) for a single inference cluster behind your firewall.
- Understand integration points: KMS/HSM, ingress/egress patterns, monitoring/metrics export options (can be pushed to your on-prem observability or stored locally).

Requested next steps (from Redwood):
1) Technical deep-dive with Vivek (SE) to validate network topology and KMS options — please confirm who from your infra team should join.
2) You to share current network diagram (attachment or internal doc) + expected throughput (rps, tokens/sec) and retention/backup requirements.
3) We’ll share our SOC2 summary and a short checklist of required firewall/IP ranges and ports.
4) If a full air-gap is required, we’ll propose an on-prem packaging option and a minimal SOW for pilot work.

- Thu 2026-11-17 15:00–16:00 PT

Thanks — quick preliminary checklist and notes from the SE side. I’ll expand during the deep-dive but this should cover the high-impact items we need to validate before a pilot.

Preliminary SE checklist (high-level):
- Deployment model options:
  * On-prem isolated cluster (no egress): Redwood Private appliance or container bundle installed on customer infra behind firewall.
  * VPC-hosted private with strict egress controls (only if customer allows private peering to Redwood infra).
- Network & IP:
  * List of allowed outbound/inbound IP ranges (we can provide a static list per cluster) — note: for true air-gap outbound should be none.
  * Required ports: 443 (TLS), 10250 (k8s apiserver where applicable), monitoring ports can be disabled for push-only flow.
  * Proxy behavior: support for forward proxies with CONNECT to allow internal package fetch during initial install; can be pre-bundled for air-gap installs to avoid runtime fetches.
- TLS / Certificates:
  * Customer-managed certs accepted. Mutual TLS supported for control plane channels.
- KMS/HSM:
  * Integration patterns: PKCS#11 and KMIP supported; we can attest to no key export if HSM enforces it. Need vendor model and access patterns.
- Telemetry / Logs:
  * Push-only telemetry to Splunk/ELK via local forwarders or file-drop; disable outbound telemetry by default for air-gap.
- Data residency & storage:
  * All model weights and caches can be hosted on local storage; no external replication. Local encryption at rest with customer keys supported.
- Operational items:
  * Backup/restore strategy for models and KV caches (we recommend periodic cold backups to on-prem object store).
  * Support windows and escalation path for pilot.

Pre-deep-dive asks for HealthSynk (please provide prior to meeting):
1) Network diagram showing firewall zones and where inference hosts will sit.
2) Expected peak and sustained throughput (rps and tokens/sec) and model selection (approx size).
3) HSM vendor/model and an example key usage flow.
4) Retention and log retention policy (where logs must live and for how long).

Suggested follow-ups from Redwood (post-meeting):
- We’ll produce a one-page pilot architecture (on-prem bundle vs private VPC) and a short SOW for a 60-day pilot including support hours and deliverables.
- Provide a hardened install artifact for an air-gap install and a checklist for customer MR.

I’m available Wed 2026-11-17 09:00–10:00 PT — I’ll accept the invite if that works for HealthSynk.
